notes.subject: גלתה
notes.rationale: KJV ritim 'Huzzab' olsem nem bilong kwin; JPS/ASV ritim 'em i kalap long sen' — tupela i no gat wanpela gutpela mining.

notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לבבהק min bel bilong tingting — Tok Pisin 'bel i holim tingting' (D4).

notes.subject: ol i singaut nogut tru
notes.rationale: מנהגות min 'ol i draivim / ol i bosim i go'; hia ol i singaut olsem man i wok long go long hevi.

notes.subject: מתפפת על לבבהן
notes.rationale: Piksa bilong tanbua: ol i kilim bel olsem drum — tanim tok i holim pasin bilong faia.

translation: Na ol i statim ⟨em⟩ — em i kalap long sen, ol i karamapim ⟨em⟩; na ol meri save bilong em ol i singaut nogut tru, olsem nois bilong ol balus, ol i patpatim bel bilong olgeta.

tokens.gloss: na ol meri save bilong em
